Ma’am, PCOD is primarily caused by a hormonal imbalance. In simple terms, it means that male hormones (androgens) are relatively higher while female hormones are lower.

Due to this imbalance, you may experience symptoms such as irregular periods, facial hair growth, hair fall, bloating, weight gain, thyroid-related issues, mood swings, and changes in appetite.

Please don’t worry—this condition can be managed effectively with the right guidance and care.
